summary: An interactive Mars survival game where players manage oxygen, water, food, and power to keep a Martian base running. Make strategic decisions, respond to simulated events, and survive a 10-day mission. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
details: Mission Survival: Mars Base is an interactive, browser-based educational game that simulates the challenges of maintaining a human habitat on Mars. The player takes the role of a mission commander and must manage four essential resources: oxygen, water, food, and electrical power. Players can choose from six mission actions, including recycling water, growing food, maintaining solar panels, checking shielding, tuning the oxygen system, and crew rest. Each day, resources are consumed, and simulated environmental events such as dust storms and water recovery can affect the base. The objective is to keep all critical resources above zero and survive a 10-day mission. The project helps users understand the importance of resource management, planning, and decision-making during space exploration. Its intended impact is to make the challenges of human survival on Mars easier and more engaging to understand. The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript and runs in a web browser. Its creativity comes from turning Mars exploration challenges into an interactive survival game where every decision has consequences. Important factors considered during development include resource balance, simple gameplay, mobile-friendly design, accessibility, and an engaging user experience. The resource values and environmental events are simplified for educational gameplay and do not represent real Mars mission measurements.
